title: Implement 5-phase seeding execution
description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- phase1-foundation.ts: Account, User (foundation tables)
- phase2-structure.ts: Scorecard hierarchy (Scorecard → Section → Score → Version)
- phase3-reference.ts: Reference data tables in parallel
- phase4-operational.ts: Operational and large-scale tables in parallel
- phase5-derived.ts: Derived/linked data tables
- Main seed.ts orchestrates all phases sequentially

## Implementation Steps
- Create seed user via createAndSignUpUser() or sign in existing
- Load secrets: PROD_API_URL, PROD_API_KEY, PROD_ACCOUNT_ID, INCLUDE_S3_SYNC, DAYS_RECENT
- Initialize production and sandbox clients
- Execute phases 1-5 in order, passing context object
- Each phase calls appropriate strategy based on table config
- Handle circular dependencies (ChatMessage parent, ScorecardExampleItem)
